Question
========
Why is it considered good practice to use RStudio Projects when working on data analysis?

Answerlist
----------

* They help organize your files, set a working directory, and keep your environment consistent

* They automatically load packages when you open RStudio, so there's no need to use `library()`

* They ensure your code runs faster by optimizing memory usage

* They prevent syntax errors by enforcing tidyverse formatting rules
